fit_reason: Whole SUV listed in cars by owner; the seller mentions running a repair shop, but it is posted as a private sale of a single vehicle.
findings: Black paint on the hood and front fenders looks somewhat dull and dusty, with a slightly flat reflection rather than deep gloss
Light dust and road film on the lower doors and rear bumper area
Unpainted gray/black lower bumper and rocker trim looks a little faded and chalky, especially on the front bumper
Front headlight lenses show slight haze
Interior dash and seats look tidy, with only light dust on the dash top and console
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 2013 Escape. The interior looks tidy, but the black paint on the hood and sides looks a bit dull in the photos and the lower bumper trim is starting to fade. We do mobile pre-sale details, including a wash, buff and trim restoration, and we can come to you. Would you like a quote?
